A Surprise for Mum: 孩子们为妈妈准备早餐惊喜。
It is Sunday morning. Mum is still sleeping. Kate and her little brother Leo want to make breakfast for her.
Kate makes two eggs and Leo puts bread on the plates. Then they add a red flower next to the cup. The flower is from the balcony.
When Mum wakes up, she sees the breakfast on the table. She is surprised and hugs them. The eggs taste a little strange, but Mum says it is the best breakfast ever.
